description: Per-project baseline error counts for tsc -p <project>/tsconfig.spec.json --noEmit. The gate fails on any regression above these numbers; PRs that drive a count down should also update this file (via tools/gates/type-check-spec.ts --update-baseline). Projects pinned at 0 cannot regress without a CI failure.

apps/admin-api-service.notes: Drift to be cleaned in a follow-up PR. Most likely contract drift in admin endpoints; same pattern as gateway-api #164.

apps/ai-service.notes: Cleaned by PR-25 (chore/ai-service-spec-baseline-cleanup-pr25). Root cause: DetectedFieldInput TS interface marked suggestedUnit/suggestedLabel/suggestedWidgetType as required, but the JSON schema (runtime contract) only required key/dataType/sampleCount. Spec test passed minimal fields per the schema and tripped strict-tsc on the over-strict interface. Fix: aligned interface optionals to schema. Locked at 0.

apps/alert-engine.notes: Largest drift in the monorepo. Alert-rule + escalation handler tests likely lag the rule schema.

apps/auth-service.notes: Drift to be cleaned in a follow-up PR. JWT / session / RBAC contract types most likely root cause.

apps/billing-service.notes: Drift to be cleaned in a follow-up PR. Subscription / invoice contract types most likely root cause.

apps/farm-service.notes: Real drift discovered when this gate ran for the first time. Common contract drift: BatchStatus.STOCKED removed (renamed?), Species/Batch DeepPartial[] vs full entity[] mismatch, NatsEventBus → OutboxPublisher type narrowing, weight property restructuring. Cleanup tracked under PROC-MEDIUM-007.

apps/hr-service.notes: Drift to be cleaned in a follow-up PR. HR domain contract types most likely root cause.

apps/hydroponics-service.notes: Cleaned by PR-26 (chore/hydroponics-service-spec-baseline-cleanup-pr26). Root cause: setup.resolver.spec.ts was pinning the pre-PLAT-HIGH-011 signature where hydroponicsStatus() took no args and returned a static response. The resolver was extended into a tenant-scoped repository.count() lookup; the spec was never updated. Rewrote spec to mock HydroponicsConfig repository, exercise tenant-aware behaviour, and pin the federation-style 'no tenant → no DB call' guard. Locked at 0.

apps/messaging-service.notes: Drift to be cleaned in a follow-up PR. NATS / outbox handler types most likely root cause.

libs/backend-common.notes: Drift to be cleaned in a follow-up PR. Shared library contract drift — fixing here unblocks downstream services.

libs/migration-harness.notes: Drift to be cleaned in a follow-up PR. Migration test harness contract drift.
